fixed_statement:
Use the assumptions and notation of Proposition 2.

For a.e. \(y\in\operatorname{int}B\),
\[
z_y=\langle \llbracket R\rrbracket,F,y\rangle
\]
is an integral \(2\)-current, and
\[
\partial z_y
=
\pm \langle \partial\llbracket R\rrbracket,F,y\rangle.
\]
Thus \(\partial z_y\) is supported in \(\partial R\), so \(z_y\) is a relative integral \(2\)-cycle in \((R,\partial R)\).
fixed_proof: Apply the standard slicing theorem for integral currents to \(T=\llbracket R\rrbracket\) and \(\Phi=F\).
